steps.text:
I did not use the monthly data tools (`monthly_list` / `monthly_get`). The latest month I could check is March 2026 LABO sales, read from a chart in the Q3 slides; I have no April–June data. My forecast for the fiscal 2026 4Q standalone quarter (April–June 2026) is **net sales 6,150, gross profit 2,980, SG&A 1,480, operating income 1,500** (¥ million). Confidence is low.

### 1. Starting point
All figures below are in ¥ million.

**Prior-year 4Q (fiscal 2025, April–June 2025)** — the base for the forecast:

| Item | Amount | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Net sales | 5,851.3 | Products 2,516 / LABO 3,335 |
| Gross profit | 3,040.4 | Margin 52.0% |
| SG&A | 1,311.8 | |
| Operating income | 1,728.5 | |

**Fiscal 2026, 9 months to 3Q:**
- Net sales 18,253.2 and operating income 4,279.1.
- The company forecast is unchanged: sales 26,300, operating income 7,287.
- That forecast implies a 4Q of sales 8,047 and operating income 3,008. Sales would have to rise about 37% year on year, which is hard to reach. I treated the company forecast as something the results will likely fall short of, not as the base.

### 2. How fiscal 2026 has been going
**Gross margin by quarter, this year vs last year:**

| Quarter | Fiscal 2026 | Fiscal 2025 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1Q | 46.9% | 49.9% | −3.0pt |
| 2Q | 54.4% | 58.5% | −4.1pt |
| 3Q | 35.0% | 47.2% | −12.2pt |

**Costs paid for out of the investment-sale gain:** in 2Q and 3Q the company spent money on growth investments, funded by a one-off gain of ¥6,762 million from selling investment securities. Most of it was booked as SG&A; part of 3Q's (mainly the bonus) appears to sit in cost of sales.
- 2Q: 453.
- 3Q: 640, of which a special bonus was 470.
- 3Q SG&A rose only 180 year on year. That suggests most of the special bonus was booked in cost of sales, since some LABO staff costs are classified there.

**Underlying margin:** if I add back about 400 for 3Q, the 3Q gross margin would be about 42.6%. That points to an underlying decline of about 3.5–4.5pt a year, from LABO price declines and costs of new stores.

**Underlying operating income:** the company's own figure excluding these costs was 1,233 in 3Q, down 7.8% year on year.

### 3. 4Q drivers
**LABO (car-coating shops):**
- Sales growth by quarter: 1Q +8.2%, 2Q +7.6%, 3Q +5.4%.
- Store count is up about 16% (171 vs 148 a year ago). But spending was hit in 3Q by higher fuel prices after tensions in the Middle East, and March was slightly below the previous year.
- Coating prices went up 8% on June 1, so customers may have bought ahead in May.
- I assume +6%: 3,335 × 1.06 ≈ 3,520.

**Products segment:**
- The "environmental performance" car tax (環境性能割) was abolished on April 1. New-car deliveries due in February–March slipped into April and later, so the new-car market should recover in 4Q.
- The aftermarket remains weak because of fuel prices.
- I assume +5%: 2,516 × 1.05 ≈ 2,640.

Total net sales ≈ 6,160, rounded to **6,150**.

### 4. Gross profit and SG&A
- **Gross margin:** 52.0% − 4pt (underlying trend) + 0.5pt (June price rise) = 48.5%. 6,150 × 48.5% ≈ **2,980**.
- **SG&A:**
  - Base: prior-year 1,312 × 1.05 (new stores, staff) ≈ 1,378.
  - Add the TV programme continuing in April–June (90 a quarter in 2Q and 3Q).
  - Add a small amount of other growth investment: about +10.
  - Total ≈ **1,480**.
- **Operating income:** 2,980 − 1,480 = **1,500** (−13% year on year).
